verdict.rationale: An identity platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from tenant data, such as logs or user activity, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. The MCP server lets external AI tools like Claude manage the tenant from outside the product. Log streaming exports logs to third-party analysis services. Adaptive MFA is a risk-based login control. All of these are adjacent or user-side approaches, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
